mentions.name: Weekly Thanksgiving cooking challenges
mentions.description: A personal series of weekly cooking challenges held through October and November to practice and refine a Thanksgiving day feast, with themed weeks such as brussel sprouts, cauliflower, and the classic sage, rosemary, and thyme seasoning blend.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the month of November (and starting in October this year) I like to hold weekly cooking challenges to practice and refine my Thanksgiving day feast. Now about 3 weeks out from the final boss level of cooking, and I'm having a week all about brussel sprouts.
